messages:
ara: Alert: a spike of SCIM deprovision failures starting ~02:12 UTC; idp-prod returned 500s for metadata fetch and many auth logs have no trace_id. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

maria: I'm on. quick log peek shows KMS unwrap errors and 'AliasNotFoundException' in the same window. Could be a key-alias mismatch.

kevin: We changed alias naming in infra templates last night; looks like a subset of pods got the new alias while others still used the old alias due to a configmap refresh race.

samir: confirmed with pod env: svc-scim instances show both ALIAS=alias/extid-v2 and alias/extid-v1. Mixed envelopes -> unwrap failures -> idp errors -> middleware didn't attach trace_id.

jess: mitigation options? Recreate old alias pointing to current CMK, or force rolling restart after fixing config propagation.

maria: recreate old alias as mirror for fast recovery, then restart workers to converge on the new alias. I'll also add a short-lived alert for Unwrap* spikes.

ops-bot: action: recreate alias alias/extid-v1 -> cmk-0a1b2c. initiated by maria at 2025-06-02T02:20:10Z.

kevin: alias recreation completed; SCIM error rate dropped back to baseline within 90s and trace_id started appearing again.

ara: follow-ups: 1) postmortem on configmap/autoscaler race 2) add pre-deploy gate to ensure alias presence in KMS 3) make trace_id assignment earlier in request path 4) add unit/integration tests for entityID canonicalization.

samir: marking this sev3 (partial provisioning outage); add threat note: inconsistent alias propagation could be exploited to cause a targeted provisioning DoS.

jess: I'll prepare a short customer timeline and link infra tickets. Closing when postmortem draft is up. :white_check_mark:
